messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [Prod] inference-service-prod high error rate (5xx/timeouts). Trigger: p99 latency > 5s and error_rate > 3% over 2m. Alert time 2026-03-15T18:02:02Z

emily (oncall): acked, I'm on it. paging in progress.

ranjit (sre): joining. pulling dashboards now — p95 jumped from ~150ms -> ~3.2s, p99 ~9s. Errors mostly 504 / 502 from gateway.

lee (eng-runtime): I see a prod rollout ~17:58 UTC (rollout id 2371109000, image inference:1.5.0). Canary looked ok in quick QA but not at scale.

emily (oncall): doing quick curl tests against /v1/generate -> lots of timeouts and 502s.

emily (oncall): command: `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -m 10 https://inference.example.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' || echo "timeout"`

emily (oncall): result: intermittent "timeout" or `HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway` in ~30-40% of calls during spike.

ranjit (sre): kubectl check: `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference -o wide` — pod CPU at 90-100% on several nodes, a few pods restarting.

ranjit (sre): relevant logs:
```
2026-03-15T17:59:12Z inference: kv-cache eviction surged, waiting for lock
2026-03-15T17:59:12Z inference: serve loop stalled at seq=512, wait-for-kv-lock=120s
2026-03-15T18:00:01Z http: upstream timeout
```

lee (eng-runtime): that stack looks like the kv-cache prefetch/lock change in 1.5.0. We saw a small perf delta internally but didn't catch long-tail lock contention.

emily (oncall): CS reports multiple customers complaining "requests hang then 504". No single customer fully blocked but several with degraded UX. tagging as potential Sev2.

ranjit (sre): mitigation options: 1) rollback to 1.4.0 (fast) 2) scale horizontally (may not help if lock contention) 3) enable routing to cached/less-concurrent model variants (more invasive).

emily (oncall): agree rollback first to stop the bleeding. recommend immediate rollback.

lee (eng-runtime): I can trigger rollback now. deploy-bot, revert rollout 2371109000 -> previous stable image inference:1.4.0

deploy-bot: Accepted: Rolling back rollout 2371109000 -> image inference:1.4.0. Initiating rollback (canary -> full). ETA ~90s. Notifying CD pipeline.

ranjit (sre): while rollback proceeds, we should reduce edge timeout to avoid huge queue backing up at gateway: set proxy_read_timeout/proxy_connect_timeout lower for a short window.

emily (oncall): applying nginx change to edge config: `proxy_connect_timeout 5s; proxy_read_timeout 5s;` applying now.

emily (oncall): applied. monitoring metrics.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. New pods launching with tag inference:1.4.0.

ranjit (sre): observability update: p95 ~180ms, p99 ~300ms, error rate back to ~0.2%. Looks like rollback mitigated the regression. :tada:

lee (eng-runtime): great. I'll open a regression PR to revert the kv-cache prefetch change and add more long-tail tests. this change introduced a lock/backoff behavior that under high concurrency causes head-of-line waits.

anna (pm): can someone summarize customer impact so we can coordinate comms?

customer-success: tracking 7 customers who reported issues via tickets/CS. Two were mid-tier with higher throughput; they saw repeated retries and some failed requests. No data loss reported. Recommending proactive outreach + credits.

dave (sre): creating an incident record and assigning postmortem owner. I'll take this. Incident ID INC-2026-0315-001.

emily (oncall): handing off to daytime team. Ranjit/Dave will continue RCA and customer coord. I'm signing off now.

ranjit (sre): ack — I'll collect detailed traces, heap/mutex metrics, and attach logs. adding timeline and rollback commit to the ticket.

dave (sre): scheduling short RCA with eng-runtime and CS tomorrow 10:00 PST. Also will review alert thresholds (the pager was triggered appropriately but we can tune for earlier detection of kv lock wait).

lee (eng-runtime): immediate follow-ups: add feature flag around prefetch logic, add CI stress test for seq lengths >512 and concurrent QPS patterns, and instrument KV wait time metric.

ranjit (sre): root cause summary (initial): 1.5.0 introduced a synchronous prefetch flow and a shared KV lock/backoff; under bursty production load this caused exponential backoff on KV accesses -> requests queued -> gateway timeouts.

dave (sre): customer impact estimate: ~7 customers affected, ~4k failed requests across ~18 minutes, no PII or billing anomalies identified. CS preparing template messages.

customer-success: drafting status page message and customer email template now. will share for review.

emily (oncall): closing handoff. if anything else appears during handover window ping @dave.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-001: status=resolved, mitigation=rollback to inference:1.4.0, owner=dave (sre). Postmortem assigned.

ranjit (sre): saving artifacts: `kibana/search?id=INC-2026-0315-001` and `github.com/redwood/inference/commits/2371109000` (links in ticket).

dave (sre): thanks team. will post a short writeup and action items after RCA. closing thread.
